description: AEngine IPS signature database adapted from OWASP Core Rule Set. Rules keep CRS targets so AEngine scans only the relevant request parts.
license_note: OWASP CRS is distributed under Apache License 2.0. This file contains adapted regex rules for educational use in the AEngine intrusions module.
selection_policy: Request-side CRS @rx rules only; response/protocol/anomaly/scanner/chain, Python-incompatible, and broad high-false-positive CRS rules are excluded.
